title: Fix up some python script issues seen with ruff
description:
Was conservative about changes to asn2wrs.py, most remaining
issues are a question of style.  Regardless, regenerated all
ASN dissectors to confirm no differences to generated code.

notes.body:
added 5 commits
  • 1289762a...bc55f82c - 4 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • 5aa6b2b6 - Fix up some python script issues seen with ruff
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/16370/diffs?diff_id=1060871982&start_sha=1289762af20d34e67ae44e0843c9c5f15295a93a)
Seeing issues on the pipeline.  Not sure when I'll be able to get back to this.

added 1 commit
  • 06f9885b - Fix up some python script issues seen with ruff
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/16370/diffs?diff_id=1063137070&start_sha=5aa6b2b67eb9b56fbe8d96317a45a3e94471b2c7)
reset approvals from @martin.r.mathieson by pushing to the branch

These issues appear to be related to stricter checks now being done by the version of python installed by the pipeline (rather than changed introduced by this MR).  @johnthacker fixed some in check_typed_item_calls.py, the others I've seen are addressed in https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/16396
